headline: Philippines Revises Second-Quarter GDP Growth Upward to 2.4 Percent
summary: The Philippine economy grew slightly faster than initially reported in the second quarter, with GDP revised upward to 2.4% ahead of the upcoming third-quarter print.
why: GDP revisions provide investors with a more accurate picture of domestic economic momentum, guiding monetary policy and fixed-income allocations in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Upward revision of Q2 GDP points to stronger economic output than previously estimated.
